purpose: TIGER road segments filed under a name that does not designate the route they carry. Each rule names the segments by LINEARID and the name TIGER gives them; the build reads them under the names in `as` instead (an empty list drops them), and fails if a segment is missing or renamed, so a TIGER edition that fixes the name is noticed.

rules.name: I- 35
rules.why: Between the split at Burnsville and the rejoin at Columbus there is no plain I-35. TIGER files I-35E's stretch from the split to Mendota Heights and from Little Canada to Columbus as I-35, so the route measured 18 of FHWA's 39.34 mi.

rules.name: I- 35
rules.why: The same for I-35W: its first 4 mi north of the split and its stretch from Roseville to Columbus are filed as I-35 (26 of 41.78 mi).

rules.name: Joe N Martin Expy
rules.why: The Joe N. Martin Expressway is I-555 and US 63 from Jonesboro to the I-555 segments TIGER numbers; filed by name alone it was context (I-555 measured 31 of 49.94 mi).

rules.name: State Rd 265
rules.why: Indiana's SR 265 was redesignated I-265 in 2019, from I-64 to the Lewis and Clark Bridge, and is still signed SR 265 east of I-65 (Wikipedia, Interstate 265). FHWA lists 13.13 mi in Indiana; 1 mi was drawn.

rules.name: US Hwy 95
rules.why: I-11 runs with US 95 from Railroad Pass to Kyle Canyon Road since May 2024, over the former I-515 (Wikipedia, Interstate 11). FHWA lists 54.19 mi; 21 were drawn.

rules.name: I- 515
rules.why: I-515 was decommissioned when I-11 replaced it; FHWA no longer lists it. Its pavement is carried by the US 95 segments above.
